entries.text: A Slime Digimon born from the fusion of a PC virus and negative human emotions. It lives in wet places and spits a poisonous froth.
A small, red-eyed Machine Digimon. It discharges electricity from its tail. It cannot move in dark places, so it lives in well lit areas.
A Seed Digimon with a clear film on its body. It has potential to digivolve into a Vegetation or Dragon Digimon. It lives where plants are abundant.
A Slime Digimon that looks like a green bubble. It stops an enemy with its bubbles and then flees.
A Slime Digimon that looks like a microorganism. It blinds its enemies with froth. It lives near the water.
A newly-born Slime Digimon. It has a squishy red body and has three antennae growing from its head. It lives in relatively mild climates.
A Slime Digimon with black hairs growing from it. It is newly-born and emits froth from its mouth. Lives almost anywhere.
A Slime Digimon found on the Internet Sea. It lives in clear waters. It is the most primitive form of all Digimon and said to be the "missing link".
A smoke Digimon that protects its digicore with smoke. It lives where the air is dirty, like in factories and volcanoes.
A Botamon-like Slime Digimon. It has white hairs growing from it. Its white body is cold and weak against heat, so it lives in cold places.
A Seed Digimon covered in soft hair. It makes itself airborne to look for the best environments. Usually seen on open grassland.
A rare Dramon-like Slime Digimon with two big horns and small wings. It stabilizes itself with air blown from its mouth.
A Micro Digimon that moves around like a bat. Using sonar with the two horns on its helmet, it is active both night and day.
A Micro Digimon with large ears. It moves energetically but is not very good at combat. It attacks by spitting froth from its mouth.
A timid Bulb Digimon with leaves on its head. It buries itself in the ground to act like a plant when it senses danger. It spits a sticky froth.
A Micro Digimon with a large horn who is covered in fur. It is very mischievous and has not yet developed the instincts to fight.
A Micro Digimon. It is very rare for an In-Training Digimon to have arms and legs. It is adept at attacking with its fangs.
A Micro Digimon that acts like a cat. Its attacks are still weak and not suited for combat.
A Micro Digimon that has ears. It has sort of a mean nature and likes to bully Koromon and Tsunomon. It is not ready for battle.
A Micro Digimon with a large flower on its head. Its root-like appendages let it float for short distances. It lives on the grasslands in herds.
A shy, Micro Digimon that looks like an infant dinosaur. It flees when it senses danger. It can't dive too deep so it lives in shallow waters.
A Fire Digimon that is engulfed in fire. It is aggressive but is not very strong. It may flee when it encounters an Aquatic or Icy Digimon.
A Micro Digimon that has a stretchy body. It can block an enemy's attacks with the versatile froth it emits.
Discovered recently, this Digimon looks like an infant dragon. It is said to be an Ancient Digimon. It is small but aggressive.
An In-Training Digimon shaped like the sun. It has a flame on its head and spends time floating in the air. Its attacking abilities are weak.
An In-Training Digimon with a body like a drop of water. It is easily affected by the Tamer who raises it.
A bipedal, Reptile Digimon. It is the epitome of Rookie Digimon. It is very brave, but limited in ability since it is still in the process of maturing.
A Mammal Digimon in a hard shell. It is said to be a descendent of an ancient species. Its physical attacks and front claws are very powerful.
A Mammal Digimon with nine tails. It is very curious and mischievous. It is small but has a very powerful electric attack.
An Amphibian Digimon that lives in water. It usually swims around in swamps and rivers. It can put its opponents to sleep with its songs.
A Beast Digimon with gloves to protect its hands until its claws fully develop. It is quick and is good at hit and run attacks.
A Mammal Digimon with large claws. It is a small Digimon, but is very aggressive and unfriendly. It attacks with paralyzing gas.
A shy, Reptile Digimon that wears a fur coat made from Garurumon. It attacks with its horn, claws and flames.
An Android Digimon with a carapace. It moves around by rolling on the ball on its stomach. Its shell has very high defensive capabilities.
A Sea Mammal Digimon. It has webbed feet and hands. It thrives better in water than on land. Fierce in water, it uses its blade like backfin to attack.
A docile, Fire Digimon with a digicore flame on its head. It will not harm others unprovoked. It uses fire in battle and is weak against water.
A Larva Digimon with lightning-bolt marks on its body. A rarity within the Insectoid Digimon. It's not nimble, but has a powerful lightning attack.
An Ore Digimon which strengthens its defense by using mineral data. It is uncontrollable when its anger erupts like a volcano.
An intelligent Digimon that looks like a lesser demon. It has no courage, so it will flee when it is at a disadvantage. Its huge club is not very strong.
A Sea Beast Digimon capable of living on the land. The red hair on its back stands up when angry. Its claws are powerful enough to crush ice.
A mysterious Beast Digimon with a horn on its head. It looks cute, but its attacks are very powerful. It is small and moves quickly.
An Insectoid Digimon that looks like a ladybug and is docile compared to its group. Protected by a hard shell, it uses static from its wings to attack.
A Puppet Digimon made of plastic blocks. It was made to look like Agumon. It is docile and loves children, but its special attack is powerful.
A Digimon said to have emerged from a medical PC. It erases nightmares and viruses. It is smart but not quick, thus not strong in battle.
A spinning, gear-shaped Machine Digimon. It is not very smart, and its normal attacks are weak, but watch out for its special attacks.
A cute, popular Mammal Digimon. It flies with big ears. It is not suited for battle since it is slow and has weak attacks.
A Vegetation Digimon with a tropical flower on its head. This flower changes its scent according to its mood. It is slow but uses poisonous attacks.
A small Evil Digimon that looks like a bat. It acts as a minion to a higher Digimon and is rarely alone. Its attacks are weak, but it uses its smarts.
This Baby Bird Digimon's wings have developed into arms. It usually lives on land and flies to escape danger. It does not move or fight very well.
A Bird Digimon that lives high in the mountains. It can't fly well, but has powerful legs, so it can run quickly up mountains. Its claw attacks are powerful.
A Mammal Digimon with cute, saggy ears. It was created by researchers as a pet. Its attacks are weak, but its voice can stun its opponents.
A Vegetation Digimon with a flower-shaped face. It has high defense due to the petal-like shells protecting its head, but has low mobility.
A Vegetation Digimon that looks like a toadstool. It has many small mushroom bombs growing from its body. It may be slow, but be wary of its bombs.
An Agumon-like Reptile Digimon. It is adept at fighting while hiding in the snow. Unlike ordinary Agumon, it is weak against fire attacks.
A Beast Humanoid Digimon that looks like a golden fox. It is highly intelligent and always calm. Rather than power, it prefers speedy attacks.
A Dramon-like Dragon Digimon. It is an ancestor of all Dramon-like Digimon. It has abilities a step above other Rookie Digimon.
A Beast Digimon born from solar data. It is very pure and has a strong sense of justice. It uses powerful flame attacks.
A Mammal Digimon born from lunar data. It looks like a rabbit and can hear well with its big ears. It is cute, but its attacks hold the power of darkness.
A Dinosaur Digimon. It is an Agumon that has found its wild side. It has no sense of justice and can unleash a powerful attack with its sharp claws.
A brightly colored Digimon that looks like Gabumon. It has sharp claws and fangs with a horn on its head. It has flashy attacks but isn't powerful.
A Vegetation Digimon that looks like Palmon. The flower on its head emits a nasty smell. It lives in warm areas and has more power than Palmon.
This Mammal Digimon resembles Patamon. It's aggressive as opposed to Patamon and uses negative energy. It can fly but is not very fast.
An Ancient Digimon that prospered in the early Digital World. It is said that it is a survivor of a combative clan and has secret powers.
A Reptile Digimon that looks like a dinosaur. It is still a Rookie Digimon but it has great potential and is very fierce.
A Mammal Digimon with skin like full-body armor that can be useful in offense as well as defense.
A tough Sea Beast Digimon with thick fur and a horn that can easily break through thick ice. It is tough and able to bear ice storms.
A Titan Wizard Digimon from another dimension. It controls powerful fire and earth magic. Its high TP allows it to unleash a series of special attacks.
A Vegetation Digimon that looks like a dead tree. It has high defense because its body is made of hard wood. It fears Fire Digimon.
A Mythical Beast Digimon with large wings. It is said that its cries call storms and its flapping creates tornadoes. Very strong and intelligent.
An Angel Digimon with divine wings. As a holy Digimon, it will not fall to evil. It utilizes its speed to launch strong short range attacks.
An Ogre Digimon that loves to battle. It travels looking for strong opponents. Beware of its special attacks.
A Beast Digimon digivolved from Gaomon. It has become a quadruped due to developed claws. Its strengthened hind legs give it great speed.
A horned beetle-like Insectoid Digimon with the power of an ant and defense of a beetle. It is not smart. Its metallic horn gives great defense.
A Beast Humanoid Digimon good at hunting. Cheerful by nature, but uncontrollable when angry. They are fast and attack with accuracy.
A Beast Humanoid Digimon that looks like a wolf. It lives in the cold and has shining blue-white fur as hard as diamond. It takes pride in its fast attacks.
A Beast Humanoid Digimon that digivolved into a Virus Garurumon. Its vicious nature has colored its fur black. Many have fallen to its attacks.
A Machine Digimon guarding the network. An evil hacker used a virus enabling control of it. Normal attacks have little effect on its defense.
An Ancient Bird Digimon without wings. It gathers energy from light and attacks with the ChibiKiwimon hiding in its body.
A Mysterious Beast Digimon with nine tails. It is known as the "God of Destruction and Peace". It can use various attacks and is very quick.
A Dinosaur Digimon with tough skin on its head. Most Digimon can't go near it due to its horn and strong attacks. It is smart and makes a good leader.
A Machine Digimon that regulates the time and space of the network. It has the ability to stop time and is much more dangerous than it looks.
A Digimon with a giant pair of mandibles on its head. The mandibles can cut an enemy in two. Its defense is not that high.
An Amphibian Digimon with a beautiful voice. It plays a song with its horn to control emotions. It is not strong, but can be a force in water battles.
A Mollusk Digimon that lives in the deep seas of the network. It is feared as the white devil of the deep seas. Its attacks are powerful and use poison.
A Beast Humanoid Digimon that uses a duct on its back to propel itself at the speed of sound. It has power and speed of a beast and wits of a human.
A Gigantic Bird Digimon with giant feet. It can't fly but its large body gives it power. It can petrify its opponents, so beware!
A Mamemon-like Mutant Digimon. It emits electricity from its magnet-like body. Moving quickly, it battles using electricity.
A Mollusk Digimon that lives in the Internet Sea. It moves between shells like a hermit crab as it grows. It is hostile and boasts high defense.
A subspecies of Greymon, this Digimon digivolved in harsh climates making it stronger. It has learned to use fire and special powers.
An Aquatic Digimon with a long body like a snake. It wanders the seas and attacks enemies. It's not intelligent but beware of its attacks.
A Digimon that was spontaneously generated from scraps of data. It has almost no intelligence or fighting power.
A Mutant Digimon found by a computer for space exploration. It is a hero that saved many planets. Its defense is higher than expected.
An Angel Digimon resembling a female warrior. It is known as the "Goddess of the Battlefield". Its graceful moves unleash powerful attacks.
A Dinosaur Digimon infected by a virus. It's a Tyrannomon gone bad. As a result, its power increased but its intelligence decreased.
A Dinosaur Digimon that looks like a T-Rex, it lives within a group. Its prized weapons are its arms and tail. Calm and smart, they are easy to tame.
A curious Holy Beast Digimon. It is small but protects itself with its claws copied from SaberLeomon. It lacks power but excels in speed.
An Evil Dragon Digimon from the Dark Area. It was born from the negative emotions of hackers. Though it lacks wit, its claw attacks are powerful.
A Dark Angel Digimon wrapped in shadowy clothes. It was once like Angemon but fell into the Dark Area. It is very smart.
A Vegetation Digimon that looks like a giant cactus. It survives in the desert by storing nutritional data in its body. It's tough but very slow.
A Reptile Digimon armored with a bladed shell. It is heavy because of its dense body data. Like a turtle, its movements are slow, but its defense is high.
A sluglike Mollusk Digimon that lives in moist climates. It throws scrap data to attack. Your Digimon may turn into this if raised incorrectly.
A Ghost Digimon born from the Dark Area. It sends viruses at night. Its normal attacks aren't powerful, but be careful of its special attacks.
A Gigantic Bird Digimon engulfed in flames. Its heat waves have defeated many who dare face it. Digimon weak against heat must be wary of its power.
A big-mouthed, carnivorous Vegetation Digimon. It will eat anything that can fit in its mouth. It won't look for battle since it's not very strong.
A Bird Digimon with strong legs. It can't fly, but it's a very fast runner. It's good at utilizing its speed for surprise attacks.
A Fire Digimon engulfed in flames. It has an aggressive nature and burns anything it touches. It is weak in icy environments.
A furry Rare Animal Digimon that usually lives quietly, not wanting to be disturbed. It is tough, but weak against Fire Digimon.
An Armored Dragon Digimon with a horn like a rhino. It is docile, but has a very hard horn longer than half its body. It has very high defense.
An Icy Digimon covered in ice and snow. Its slow and cute actions soothe the heart. It is strong, but dislikes battles, and is weak against Meramon.
A Composition Digimon with a unicorn's horn to attack and pegasus' wings to fly. It has a temper but once tamed, it is loyal to its owner.
Unlike Kyubimon, this nine tailed Mysterious Beast Digimon is feared to bring destruction and decay. It has high TP so beware of its fire attacks.
A Beast Digimon that looks like a wild cat engulfed in flames. It lives in hot areas and is adept at using fire attacks. A rival of Garurumon.
A decayed, Undead Digimon. Despite being made into a machine to stabilize it, its data is breaking. It lacks thought, but its attacks are powerful.
Known as "Noble Hero" and "King of the Beasts", this Digimon is a source of legends. It knows justice, has a strong will and has high defense and power.
A Vegiemon in its true form. It digivolved in harsh conditions, making it very strong. Its red color serves as a warning of the poison it holds.
A Dragon Digimon with a blue body that lives in the mountains. Adapting to harsh conditions gave it huge wings for swift flight.
A green, Dragon Digimon that digivolved from Dracomon. It is not good at flying, but uses its legs to travel at amazing speeds.
A Beast Digimon known as the "Flying Lion". It guards a certain ruin in the Digital World. It is adept at fire attacks, and is a charismatic leader.
A Beast Humanoid Digimon with amazing jumping ability. It skillfully battles using great speed. There is something mystical about it.
A Dark Angel Digimon said to be the digivolved form of a particularly evil Devimon. Highly intelligent, it can freeze opponents with its wings.
A Garurumon-like Beast Digimon that lives in the darkness and is very violent. Though it seems to be a Virus, most are actually Vaccine.
A Numemon-like Mollusk Digimon. It likes filthy areas. It is not strong, yet its ferocity makes it attack. It will battle endlessly even if it loses.
From another Digital World and related to Wizardmon, this Digimon controls the powers of light and ice. It can heal itself with its holy powers.
A Kokatorimon-like Bird Digimon that can't fly. Its weapons are powerful legs and flame attacks. It moves rather slowly and is not suited for battle.
A Birdramon-like Gigantic Bird Digimon with flaming black wings. It is fierce and difficult to approach. It soars and aims for its prey from the sky.
An Icy Digimon covered in ice. It is unknown if it mutated or digivolved from Gotsumon. It has high defense, but is weak against Fire Digimon.
A rare Mythical Dragon Digimon. It has amazing power, and when cornered, it becomes even stronger than an Ultimate Digimon.
A Digimon known as the "Crimson Demon." It has a violent nature, but depending on how it is raised it may fight for justice.
A digivolved version of a Kabuterimon. Its power and defense have become stronger. Its reinforced horn is powerful in battle.
Born from the data of ancient life, this Crustacean Digimon has a shell with high defense. It uses its two tentacles and tail blade to attack.
A humanoid Digimon. It was built as a prototype of an Android Digimon. It is quite powerful.
A Puppet Digimon in a high defense monkey suit. Do not underestimate its powerful attacks. It has high resistence to all attribute based attacks.
An Angel Digimon in the form of a beautiful woman. Its 8 wings display its great abilities which give it goddess status in the Digital World.
A digivolved version of Kuwagamon. Its destructive impulse made it digivolve. Its defensive power and scissor attacks have been improved.
A winged Bird Humanoid Digimon with giant claws. Its size does not prevent it from moving quick with powerful attacks. It loves nature and protects it.
A Mutant Digimon evolved from a desktop trashcan. It has a black hole which traps all that goes in. It leads filth Digimon, but is weak itself.
This Android Digimon wears special rubber armor which can withstand any attack and also makes it more powerful.
A Vegetation Digimon that digivolved from a Woodmon. As "King of the Forest", it casts illusions on those entering its forest. It is slow, but tough.
A skeletal Undead Digimon. It has no intelligence and has only the instinct to fight. It moves slowly but has powerful special attacks.
A digivolved Ikkakumon that smashes its foe with Vulcan's Hammer made of chrome Digizoid. Its toned body gives it strong attack and defense.
A Digimon born from a boat's computer virus. Though it looks humanoid, it is a digivolved Mollusk Digimon. It attacks using its powerful tentacles.
A Fire Digimon digivolved from Meramon. Its blue flame now has more power. It still has its weakness, but its attack and defense increased.
A Bird Digimon with a plant growing out of its back. An odd fruit can be found growing on it. Since it can't fly, it is slow, but has strong attacks.
A digivolved Gekomon resembling a shogun. This Amphibian Digimon plays music with its horns and attacks with its voice. It is slow, but tough.
A calm, Horned Dragon Digimon that can destroy obstacles with its three horns. Its skin is as tough as metal and provides a strong defense.
A Warrior Digimon wearing chrome Digizoid armor. Once it finds a lord, it stays loyal to the end. A power fighter, it uses a sword as tall as itself.
A parrot-like Gigantic Bird Digimon that came from a rift in time and space. Smart and hating conflict, it can use its claws and speed if needed.
A Digimon wearing a wetsuit. It swims quickly using the motor on its back. Strong in water battles, but weak on land.
A panda-like Puppet Digimon with a sour nature and charmless actions. It doesn't look strong, but its powerful blows have defeated many Digimon.
A Mutant Digimon that is larger than Mamemon. It acts as the leader of the small Mamemon who follow it. Its large size helps against attacks.
A Pixie Digimon that uses magic. It's small, but can seal its opponent's powers. Its quick moves and abilities are its strengths.
A Ghost Digimon that looks like the Grim Reaper. It is feared as a high level ghost that brings death. It uses its scythe for its special attack.
An Alien Digimon from outer space. Its origins are unknown. It unleashes a mysterious attack. As its large head indicates, it is highly intelligent.
A Sea Mammal Digimon that is comprised of data that even a super computer can't process. It is the toughest Digimon of them all.
A High Angel Digimon with 8 silver wings. It is the representative of Light that keeps public order. Well-balanced in speed, attack and defense.
An Android Digimon digivolved from GaoGamon. It can exceed the speed of sound with its rocket engine and is good at hit-and-run attacks.
A Mutant Digimon that looks like a bomb. It may look cute, but it uses its speed and huge bombs as weapons to attack.
An Ancient Beast Digimon said to have existed eons ago. It emerged from the ice due to global warming. It is powerful and tough, but is weak against heat.
Countless battles have made Seadramon digivolve into this Aquatic Digimon. It is bigger with a blade on its head capable of generating electricity.
A modified Android Digimon with amazing power. It contains a program to destroy all. Both its arms have unstoppable power.
As a mechanized Greymon, this Android Digimon's digivolution process is incomplete, but it still has attacks reminiscent of nuclear blasts.
A completely digivolved Greymon, this Android Digimon's mechanized body surpasses all of Greymon's abilities. It boasts power and toughness.
An Android Digimon modified for ground counterattacks. It deflects attacks and has powerful jaws to crush opponent's armor.
A Puppet Digimon that looks like a teddy bear. Though it has a mean look, its overflowing love brings joy. Its fluffy body has high defense.
A Mysterious Bird Digimon that looks like a crow with 3 legs. It looks evil, but is said to be the guide to El Dorado. Be wary of its quick claws.
An Android Digimon similar to MetalGreymon. The revolver on its left hand can be fired or used in combat. It's mechanized, heavily armed and fast.
An Android Digimon that digivolved from Gargomon. It has very accurate attacks and its speed has increased.
A Pixie Digimon born from a flower. It flies using its 4 wings and can trail a nice breeze with them. It looks like a child, but it hides great power.
A female Dark Angel Digimon of a noble figure in the dark world. She has many followers and attacks using her dark powers.
A Monzaemon-like, evil-looking Puppet Digimon. It is equipped with a bear claw and a tough fluffy body.
A Beast Humanoid Digimon digivolved from Garurumon. It has lost its speed, but its attack and defense have improved. A very good partner to have on a team.
A Beast Humanoid Digimon digivolved into a Virus from Garurumon. Its abilities are the same as its Vaccine counterpart, but its kick attack is powerful.
A Dragon Digimon with huge wings. It spends most of its time airborne, and can fly at Mach 20! Few Digimon can survive an aerial battle with it.
A deadly Dragon Digimon that has a large arm on its back which is said to have evolved from wings. Very fierce, most all who face it have fallen.
A Beast Humanoid Digimon with a magnificent mane. Like Leomon, it will do anything for its ally. It uses many types of flame attacks.
This graceful Digimon uses a unique weapon during battle. Its attack power is said to double when it absorbs the light from the moon. It's very quick.
A Mutant Digimon from Starmon. It hides itself with sunglasses. Its defense is high, and its charisma has brought out potential for leadership.
A Rapidmon capable of night fighting. Its color is now black so it can easily hide in the darkness. It's quick and has strong attacks.
A Fire Digimon burning at extremely high temperatures. It wants to burn anything it touches. It is hotter than Meramon, so it is not affected by cold.
A Beast Humanoid Digimon, and ruler of the permafrost land. The morning star "Mjollnir" on its back can destroy a mountain in one blow.
A Warrior Digimon that appears in folk tales. It is said to recycle data of defeated war heroes into DigiEggs. It is quick, attacking like a gale.
A Dragon Humanoid Digimon in chrome Digizoid armor. It is slim-like in appearance, but its strength far exceeds any Mega Digimon.
A secretly created Android Digimon. It is an improved MetalSeadramon with better defense and attacks. It is very dangerous when faced in the water.
A Mega Kuwagamon that lives deep in the woods and is considered one of the most dangerous Insectoid Digimon with its powerful attacks.
A Mythical Beast Digimon which is part bird, beast, and snake. It is quick and strong and has huge wings. It lives in the desert and mountainous areas.
A Digimon in highly protective chrome Digizoid armor. It is said to be a digivolved Parrotmon. It attacks by charging its enemy.
An Ancient Beast Digimon said to be an ancestor of Leomon. It can move at mach speed and attacks with its fierce fangs and claws.
A Shining Dragon Digimon which uses solar energy. It looks like a huge humanoid robot. It has numerous close range and long range attacks.
A skeletal Undead Mammothmon infected by a virus. It holds a grudge against the virus that killed it. It is very tough, but not very smart.
A heavily armed Machine Digimon. It is armed with many weapons and can attack in any direction, but it is rather slow.
An improved Andromon. Its body is made of chrome Digizoid that gives it much higher attack and defense.
A Beast Humanoid Digimon loyal to its own sense of justice. Only the victorious can become one. Good with defense and close range combat.
A Digimon that looks like a clown. It shows up unexpectedly and without reason. It is very powerful despite its appearance.
A Digimon created from a cursed Cherrymon. It is shaped like a puppet. Beware of the hammer it wields.
A Digimon that held absolute power in the ancient Digital World. It is not very powerful, but its special attacks are strong.
A Mutant Digimon born from a computer virus created by a hacker. It is small but has one of the most defiant natures in the Digital World.
This greatly feared "Black Draconian Knight" hates cowards despite its dark side. It won't associate with unrefined Virus Digimon.
A Mutant Digimon created with Royal data. This "Prince" of Mamemon wears a cape and crown. Despite its look, it has a deadly special attack.
A Digimon found in a computer researching unknown species. It is strong in water battles and takes advantage of its large size.
A Mega Insectoid Digimon created by data from Kabuterimon and Kuwagamon. It has both high defense and attack capabilities.
A Holy Beast Digimon with 4 golden wings. It is the epitome of Holy and Bird Digimon with powerful abilities. Its special attack is powerful.
A Beast Knight Digimon that looks like a knight in a red cape. It is covered in chrome Digizoid armor and fights with many swift attacks.
Made from Android Digimon parts, this Digimon is said to be the strongest in the Digital World. Its power overwhelms all other Digimon.
An Android Digimon digivolved from Etemon. It excels in defense against both physical and attribute attacks thanks to its chrome Digizoid.
This metallic form of Garurumon can now fly. Its whole body is filled with weapons, and few Digimon can escape from it.
The Virus MetalGarurumon. Its whole body is filled with weapons and it fires missiles blindly at opponents.
An Aquatic Digimon in a chrome Digizoid body that deflects various attacks. It is the fastest Digimon under water and never lets prey escape.
Called "Queen of Flowers", this rose-shaped Digimon has a female form and dons a Tifaret jewel. It is a balanced fighter with grace and beauty.
An Android Digimon that is equipped with the Zeed Cannon. It is an offshoot of MetalGarurumon and specializes in attacks.
"The Great Dragon Warrior". It wears chrome Digizoid armor and is an offshoot of WarGreymon. It is a powerful fighter.
A Dragon Humanoid Digimon wearing full-body armor. This form can only be achieved by Dragon Digimon that complete special training.
A machine Dragon Digimon that has assimilated various data from heavy construction equipment. It is feared as the ultimate destructive dragon.
A Deity Digimon that can control nature. Its flame abilities are so powerful they can melt through anything. It is a very defensive fighter.
A Deity Digimon that can control nature. It rules ice and water and can fight in absolute zero temperatures. Its speedy attacks are deadly.
An Ancient Dragon Digimon that existed in ancient times. It is one of the greatest Digimon with its amazing power and high intelligence.
The highest ranked Holy Knight Digimon. It wears chrome Digizoid armor and has a spear in its right hand and a shield in its left. It is very chivalrous.
